Class SecondShipBuildingState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.ShipBuildingState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.SecondShipBuildingState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateInterface
public non-sealed class SecondShipBuildingState extends ShipBuildingState implements GameStateInterface
Represents the ship building state for games of level SECOND, where players can build their ships and manage forecasts.
